summary: Union County, OR 1930s lookout in Umatilla NF; a 1935 panorama survives; sources disagree on height; listed as gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Register and the Forest Fire Lookout Association Oregon list both mark it gone; no removal date is given

events.note: Panorama of the lookout dated August 2, 1935; credited to National Archives Pacific Northwest Region
Registered July 26, 2011; nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.quote: Built in the 1930s, this tower is now gone.

evidence.supports: design: observation tower with a house; listed as Gone
panorama dated 8-2-1935, courtesy National Archives Pacific Northwest Region
evidence.quote: Balloon Tree Lookout panoramic 8-2-1935 - courtesy of National Archives-Pacific Northwest Region

evidence.supports: tower and camera heights recorded as 65 and 4 feet
image courtesy National Archives Pacific Northwest Region
Oregon list: Balloon Tree, Tower Gone, US 1105, OR 461
evidence.quote: Union Balloon Tree 45.72640 -117.98064 Tower Gone FFLOS US 1105, OR 461

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com gives a 70-foot observation tower; the 1935 Osborne panorama record lists tower and camera heights as 65 and 4 feet. Neither is confirmed, so height_m is left unset.

sources.title: Balloon Tree Lookout Site
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites (Forest Fire Lookout Association)

notes_for_editor: Build date is only the decade (1930s); no source gives a year, so no built event is recorded. Height conflict (70 ft vs 65 ft tower height) is left unresolved. No source describes current condition or access, so access is unset. The 1935 panorama is on firetower.org and iamwho.com; no image URLs were captured, so no photo records were added.
